xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5151: New installations default to claude.permissionMode auto; existing installations keep their current mode

plan.title: New installations default to claude.permissionMode auto; existing installations keep their current mode
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: 34 files across 8 path prefixes, but nearly every file gets a 1-15 line change and the parts cannot ship separately: flipping the default without the pin changes the flags of every existing installation (violates FR-2), and flipping it without the launch guard and doctor row strands new installations on per-tool-call prompts (violates FR-5). Docs and the changelog describe the combined behavior. Items are already split per concern so each is reviewable alone.

narratives.Problem: New Overdeck installations launch every Claude Code agent with --permission-mode bypassPermissions because DEFAULT_CONFIG.claude.permissionMode and every fallback say bypass (decision of 2026-07-12). The operator wants new installations in Overdeck's hook-moderated auto mode while every installation that exists today keeps the mode it runs with.
narratives.Proposal: Flip DEFAULT_CONFIG and all fallbacks to auto. Add a one-time pin (CLI entry + dashboard boot, marker file) that writes claude.permissionMode: bypass into config.yaml on homes that already had config.yaml, config.toml or overdeck.db and no valid key. Add a launch guard that registers the auto-approve hook or refuses the launch under auto at every local Claude Code launch site, refuse remote Fly agents under auto, add a pan doctor row, mark Auto recommended in Settings, and update docs and the changelog.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Changing Codex or ACP permission defaults
- Mapping Overdeck auto to a different Claude Code flag (#3760)
- Provisioning Overdeck hooks on Fly VMs
- Removing the project-layer (.pan.yaml) claude.permissionMode setting
- Changing runModelSummary (headless -p)
- Making config load write anything
- Re-running the pin after its marker exists

autoDecisions.summary: Meet FR-2 with a one-time pin plus marker (~/.overdeck/.claude-permission-mode-pin.json), run at CLI entry before parseAsync and at dashboard boot before the listener
autoDecisions.rationale: pan start/strike/knowledge spawn in the CLI process, so neither pan sync nor dashboard boot alone runs before the first post-upgrade spawn; postinstall is best-effort. Running once with a marker avoids pinning new installs whose config.yaml a single-key writer created later.

autoDecisions.summary: Classify a home as existing when config.yaml, config.toml or overdeck.db exists at the pin's first run
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's Why requires every current installation to keep bypass; pan install writes config.toml (not config.yaml) and desktop installs may only have overdeck.db. On a fresh home the pin runs before any of these is written.

autoDecisions.summary: An invalid present claude.permissionMode value is replaced with bypass by the pin
autoDecisions.rationale: It resolves to the bypass default today; leaving it would silently flip that installation to auto.
The issue's proposed default; auto is less permissive and the launch guard prevents stranding.

autoDecisions.summary: Remote Fly agents under auto are refused with an error, not pinned to bypass
autoDecisions.rationale: Fly VMs never have Overdeck hooks (fly-provider writes only theme + defaultMode), so auto there prompts forever; silently bypassing would break the locked remote no-leak trust property.

autoDecisions.summary: Launch guard sits in both command builders, the claude-code resume branch, spawnConversationSession and the planning message route; runModelSummary is exempt
autoDecisions.rationale: These are every local interactive Claude Code launch path not already covered by ensureLifecycleHooksBeforeLaunch; headless -p denies rather than prompts.

autoDecisions.summary: The issue's claudish bypass pin (NFR-1) is not preserved because it no longer exists in code; the stale docs caveat is removed
autoDecisions.rationale: git grep finds claudish only in two comments, and permission-mode-leak.test.ts asserts non-Anthropic providers honor auto.

autoDecisions.summary: The pin writes atomically with comments preserved, without a separate backup file or the settings write queue
autoDecisions.rationale: One key is edited via yaml setIn; the in-process queue cannot protect cross-process writes, and the pin runs before the dashboard serves requests.
